    alumno: "Ceballos Chávez Ángel Rosario",
    tema: "Aislamiento e identificación de hongos fitopatógenos en cultivo de durazno (Prunus persica L. Batsch.) en el sur de Chihuahua y el efecto antagónico de Trichoderma asperellum.",
    comite: "Dra. Blanca Elvira López Valenzuela, Dra. Glenda Judith Lizárraga Sánchez, Dr. Rubén Félix Gastélum, Dra. Karla Yeriana Leyva Madrigal, Dr. Carlos Patricio Sauceda Acosta.",
    cohorte: "2020-2024"
  },
  {
    alumno: "Herrera Rodríguez Gabriel",
    tema: "Aspectos epidemiológicos y de control del hongo Sclerotium rolfsii causante de la pudrición sureña de la papa en el estado de Sinaloa y Sonora.",
    comite: "Dr. Gabriel Antonio Lugo García.",
    cohorte: "2020-2024"
  },
  {
    alumno: "Calderón Alonso Alma Carolina",
    tema: "Validación de un programa de evaluación y clasificación de canales bovinas mexicanas.",
    comite: "Dr. Francisco Gerardo Ríos Rincón.",
    cohorte: "2020-2024"
  },
  {
    alumno: "González Molotla Iris Alejandrina",
    tema: "Aislamiento, identificación y patogenicidad de hongos de la madera asociados a la muerte descendente del arándano (Vaccinium corymbosum L), en el norte de Sinaloa y su manejo biorracional.",
    comite: "Dr. Fernando Alberto Valenzuela Escoboza.",
    cohorte: "2020-2024"
  },
  {
    alumno: "Mejía Lastra Antonio de Jesús",
    tema: "Enfriamiento de ganado lechero Holstein durante el periodo seco: efectos en la vaca y su ternero.",
    comite: "Dra. Teresa de Jesús Velázquez, Dr. Leonel Avendaño Reyes.",
    cohorte: "2020-2024"
  }
  ];
  const $DCA = (s) => document.querySelector(s);

  const busqDCA   = $DCA('#busquedaAlumnoDCA');
  const filtroDCA = $DCA('#filtroCohorteDCA');
  const tablaDCA  = $DCA('#tablaTesisDCA tbody');
  const pagerDCA  = $DCA('#paginacionDCA');

  if (!busqDCA || !filtroDCA || !tablaDCA || !pagerDCA) {
    return;
  }

  const PAGE_SIZE_DCA = 10;
  let currentPageDCA = 1;

  const cohortesDCA = Array
    .from(new Set(DATA_DCA.map(r => r.cohorte)))
    .sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));

  cohortesDCA.forEach((c) => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = c;
    opt.textContent = c;
    filtroDCA.appendChild(opt);
  });

  function sortByAlumnoDCA(arr) {
    return arr.slice().sort((a, b) =>
      a.alumno.localeCompare(b.alumno, 'es', { sensitivity: 'base' })
    );
  }

  function renderDCA() {
    const texto = (busqDCA.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const coh   = filtroDCA.value;

    let filtered = DATA_DCA.filter((r) => {
      const coincideTxt = !texto || r.alumno.toLowerCase().includes(texto);
      const coincideCoh = (coh === 'todos') || r.cohorte === coh;
      return coincideTxt && coincideCoh;
    });

    filtered = sortByAlumnoDCA(filtered);

    const total       = filtered.length;
    const totalPages  = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE_DCA));
    if (currentPageDCA > totalPages) currentPageDCA = 1;

    const start    = (currentPageDCA - 1) * PAGE_SIZE_DCA;
    const pageRows = filtered.slice(start, start + PAGE_SIZE_DCA);

    tablaDCA.innerHTML = pageRows.length
      ? pageRows.map((r) => `
          <tr>
            <td>${r.alumno}</td>
            <td>${r.tema}</td>
            <td>${r.comite}</td>
            <td>${r.cohorte}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('')
      : `
        <tr>
          <td colspan="4" class="text-center py-4">
            No se encontraron coincidencias.
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;

    renderPagerDCA(totalPages);
  }

  function renderPagerDCA(totalPages) {
    const li = (label, page, disabled = false, active = false, aria = '') => `
      <li class="page-item ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} ${active ? 'active' : ''}">
        <a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="${page}" ${aria}>${label}</a>
      </li>
    `;

    let html = '';

  
    html += li(
      '«',
      Math.max(1, currentPageDCA - 1),
      currentPageDCA === 1,
      false,
      'aria-label="Anterior"'
    );

   
    const windowSize = 2;
    const pages = [];
    for (let p = 1; p <= totalPages; p++) {
      if (p <= 2 || p > totalPages - 2 || Math.abs(p - currentPageDCA) <= windowSize) {
        pages.push(p);
      }
    }
    const unique = [...new Set(pages)].sort((a, b) => a - b);

    unique.forEach((p, i) => {
      html += li(p, p, false, p === currentPageDCA);

     
      if (i < unique.length - 1 && unique[i + 1] !== p + 1) {
        html += `
          <li class="page-item disabled">
            <span class="page-link">…</span>
          </li>
        `;
      }
    });

    html += li(
      '»',
      Math.min(totalPages, currentPageDCA + 1),
      currentPageDCA === totalPages,
      false,
      'aria-label="Siguiente"'
    );

    pagerDCA.innerHTML = html;


    pagerDCA.querySelectorAll('a.page-link').forEach((a) => {
      a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = Number(a.getAttribute('data-page'));
        if (!Number.isNaN(target) && target >= 1) {
          currentPageDCA = target;
          renderDCA();
          document
            .getElementById('tablaTesisDCA')
            .scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });
    });
  }


  busqDCA.addEventListener('input', () => {
    currentPageDCA = 1;
    renderDCA();
  });

  filtroDCA.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentPageDCA = 1;
    renderDCA();
  });


  renderDCA();
})();
</script>

  // ================================================

  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);

  // ✅ IDs QUE SÍ EXISTEN EN TU HTML "Tesis en Proceso"
  const busq   = $('#busquedaAlumno');
  const filtro = $('#filtroCohorte');
  const tbody  = $('#tablaTesis tbody');
  const pager  = $('#paginacion');

  if (!busq || !filtro || !tbody || !pager) {
    console.warn('No se encontraron elementos. Revisa IDs en el HTML.');
    return;
  }

  const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
  let currentPage = 1;

  // Poblar select de cohortes (tu HTML usa "todos")
  const cohortes = Array.from(new Set(DATA_TESIS_MCA.map(r => (r.cohorte || '').trim())))
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));

  cohortes.forEach((c) => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = c;
    opt.textContent = c;
    filtro.appendChild(opt);
  });

  function escapeHtml(str){
    return String(str ?? '')
      .replace(/&/g,'&')
      .replace(/</g,'<')
      .replace(/>/g,'>');
  }

  function render() {
    const texto = (busq.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const cohSeleccionada = filtro.value; // "todos" o cohorte

    let filtered = DATA_TESIS_MCA.filter((r) => {
      const nombre = (r.alumno || '').toLowerCase();
      const okTxt = !texto || nombre.includes(texto);
      const okCoh = (cohSeleccionada === 'todos') || r.cohorte === cohSeleccionada;
      return okTxt && okCoh;
    });

    // Ordenar por alumno
    filtered.sort((a, b) =>
      (a.alumno || '').localeCompare((b.alumno || ''), 'es', { sensitivity: 'base' })
    );

    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = 1;

    const start = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
    const pageRows = filtered.slice(start, start + PAGE_SIZE);

    // ✅ 4 columnas (Alumno, Tema, Comité, Cohorte) como tu HTML
    tbody.innerHTML = pageRows.length
      ? pageRows.map((r) => `
          <tr>
            <td>${escapeHtml(r.alumno)}</td>
            <td>${escapeHtml(r.tema)}</td>
            <td>${escapeHtml(r.comite)}</td>
            <td>${escapeHtml(r.cohorte)}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('')
      : '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center py-4">No se encontraron resultados</td></tr>';

    renderPager(totalPages);
  }

  function renderPager(totalPages) {
    const li = (label, page, disabled = false, active = false, aria = '') => `
      <li class="page-item ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} ${active ? 'active' : ''}">
        <a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="${page}" ${aria}>${label}</a>
      </li>
    `;

    let html = '';

    html += li('«', Math.max(1, currentPage - 1), currentPage === 1, false, 'aria-label="Anterior"');

    const windowSize = 2;
    const pages = [];
    for (let p = 1; p <= totalPages; p++) {
      if (p <= 2 || p > totalPages - 2 || Math.abs(p - currentPage) <= windowSize) pages.push(p);
    }
    const unique = [...new Set(pages)].sort((a, b) => a - b);

    unique.forEach((p, i) => {
      html += li(p, p, false, p === currentPage);
      if (i < unique.length - 1 && unique[i + 1] !== p + 1) {
        html += `<li class="page-item disabled"><span class="page-link">…</span></li>`;
      }
    });

    html += li('»', Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1), currentPage === totalPages, false, 'aria-label="Siguiente"');

    pager.innerHTML = html;

    pager.querySelectorAll('a.page-link').forEach((a) => {
      a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = Number(a.getAttribute('data-page'));
        if (!Number.isNaN(target) && target >= 1) {
          currentPage = target;
          render();
          document.getElementById('tablaTesis')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  busq.addEventListener('input', () => { currentPage = 1; render(); });
  filtro.addEventListener('change', () => { currentPage = 1; render(); });

  render();
})();
</script>

  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);

  const busq = $('#busquedaAlumno');
  const filtro = $('#filtroCohorte');
  const tbody = $('#tablaEgresados tbody');
  const pager = $('#paginacion');

  if (!busq || !filtro || !tbody || !pager) {
    return;
  }

  const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
  let currentPage = 1;

  const cohortes = [...new Set(DATA_EGRESADOS_DCA.map(e => e.cohorte))]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));

  cohortes.forEach((c) => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = c;
    opt.textContent = c;
    filtro.appendChild(opt);
  });

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str ?? '')
      .replace(/&/g, '&')
      .replace(/</g, '<')
      .replace(/>/g, '>');
  }

  function render() {
    const texto = (busq.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const cohorteSeleccionada = filtro.value;

    let filtered = DATA_EGRESADOS_DCA.filter((e) => {
      const nombre = (e.nombre || '').toLowerCase();
      const okTxt = !texto || nombre.includes(texto);
      const okCoh = cohorteSeleccionada === 'todos' || e.cohorte === cohorteSeleccionada;
      return okTxt && okCoh;
    });

    filtered.sort((a, b) =>
      a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre, 'es', { sensitivity: 'base' })
    );

    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = 1;

    const start = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
    const pageRows = filtered.slice(start, start + PAGE_SIZE);

    tbody.innerHTML = pageRows.length
      ? pageRows.map((e) => `
        <tr>
          <td>${escapeHtml(e.nombre)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(e.cohorte)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(e.director)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(e.correo)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(e.ocupacion)}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('')
      : '<tr><td colspan="5">No se encontraron resultados</td></tr>';

    renderPager(totalPages);
  }

  function renderPager(totalPages) {
    const li = (label, page, disabled = false, active = false) => `
      <li class="page-item ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} ${active ? 'active' : ''}">
        <a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="${page}">${label}</a>
      </li>
    `;

    let html = '';

    html += li('«', Math.max(1, currentPage - 1), currentPage === 1);

    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
      html += li(i, i, false, i === currentPage);
    }

    html += li('»', Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1), currentPage === totalPages);

    pager.innerHTML = html;

    pager.querySelectorAll('a.page-link').forEach((a) => {
      a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        currentPage = Number(a.dataset.page);
        render();
      });
    });
  }

  busq.addEventListener('input', () => {
    currentPage = 1;
    render();
  });

  filtro.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentPage = 1;
    render();
  });

  render();
})();

</script>

  ];
  const searchInput = document.getElementById("busquedaPublicacionesMCA");
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById("filtroAnioMCA");
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tablaPublicacionesMCA tbody");
  const pager = document.getElementById("paginacionPublicacionesMCA");

  if (!searchInput || !yearSelect || !tbody || !pager) {
    console.error("No se encontraron elementos HTML requeridos.");
    return;
  }

  const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
  let currentPage = 1;
  let filteredData = [...publicacionesMCA];

  function normalize(value) {
    return String(value || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
  }

  function populateYears() {
    const years = [...new Set(publicacionesMCA.map(item => item.anio))]
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));

    years.forEach(year => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = year;
      option.textContent = year;
      yearSelect.appendChild(option);
    });
  }

  function applyFilters() {
    const searchTerm = normalize(searchInput.value);
    const selectedYear = yearSelect.value;

    filteredData = publicacionesMCA.filter(item => {
      const matchesSearch =
        normalize(item.autor).includes(searchTerm) ||
        normalize(item.titulo).includes(searchTerm) ||
        normalize(item.congreso).includes(searchTerm) ||
        normalize(item.tipoParticipacion).includes(searchTerm) ||
        normalize(item.pais).includes(searchTerm) ||
        normalize(item.anio).includes(searchTerm);

      const matchesYear =
        selectedYear === "todas" || item.anio === selectedYear;

      return matchesSearch && matchesYear;
    });

    currentPage = 1;
    renderTable();
    renderPagination();
  }

  function renderTable() {
    tbody.innerHTML = "";

    if (!filteredData.length) {
      tbody.innerHTML = `
        <tr>
          <td colspan="6" class="text-center py-4">
            No se encontraron publicaciones.
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;
      return;
    }

    const start = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
    const end = start + PAGE_SIZE;
    const pageItems = filteredData.slice(start, end);

    pageItems.forEach(item => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");

      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${item.autor}</td>
        <td>${item.titulo}</td>
        <td>${item.congreso}</td>
        <td>${item.tipoParticipacion}</td>
        <td>${item.pais}</td>
        <td>${item.anio}</td>
      `;

      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function renderPagination() {
    pager.innerHTML = "";

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredData.length / PAGE_SIZE);

    if (totalPages <= 1) return;

    const createButton = (label, page, disabled = false, active = false) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.className = `page-item ${disabled ? "disabled" : ""} ${active ? "active" : ""}`;

      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.className = "page-link";
      btn.textContent = label;

      if (!disabled) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          currentPage = page;
          renderTable();
          renderPagination();
        });
      }

      li.appendChild(btn);
      pager.appendChild(li);
    };

    createButton("«", currentPage - 1, currentPage === 1);

    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
      createButton(i, i, false, i === currentPage);
    }

    createButton("»", currentPage + 1, currentPage === totalPages);
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener("input", applyFilters);
  yearSelect.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);

  populateYears();
  renderTable();
  renderPagination();
})();
	</script>

<style>
:root{
  --uas-azul:   #0a3a82;
  --uas-dorado: #f0b400;

  --fondo:      #f8fafc;
  --borde:      rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}

/* === Card filtros === */
.card-filtros{
  border:1px solid var(--borde);
  border-top:4px solid var(--uas-dorado);
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  border-radius:12px;
}

/* === Contenedor tabla === */
.table-wrap{
  border:1px solid var(--borde);
  border-radius:12px;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  background:#fff;
}

/* === Encabezado tabla === */
table.tabla-uas thead th{
  background:var(--uas-azul);
  color:#fff!important;
  font-weight:700;
  text-align:center;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--uas-dorado);
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}

/* === Ajustes de tabla === */
.table-responsive{
  overflow-x:auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}

table.tabla-uas{
  width:100%;
  table-layout:auto;
}

table.tabla-uas th,
table.tabla-uas td{
  text-align:center;
  vertical-align:middle;
  white-space:normal !important;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere !important;
  word-break:break-word;
  padding:.75rem .8rem;
  font-size:0.95rem;
}

/* Alumno y ocupación hacia la izquierda */
table.tabla-uas td:nth-child(1),
table.tabla-uas td:nth-child(5){
  text-align:left;
}

/* Cohorte */
table.tabla-uas th:nth-child(2),
table.tabla-uas td:nth-child(2){
  min-width:130px;
  white-space:nowrap;
  text-align:center;
}

/* === Colores alternos === */
table.tabla-uas tbody tr:nth-child(odd)>*{
  background-color:rgba(240,180,0,.14)!important;
}
table.tabla-uas tbody tr:nth-child(even)>*{
  background-color:rgba(10,58,130,.12)!important;
}

/* === Paginación === */
.paginacion-wrap{
  border:1px solid var(--borde);
  border-top:0;
  border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;
  padding:.5rem .75rem;
  background:#fff;
}
.pagination .page-link{
  border-color:var(--borde);
}
.pagination .page-item.active .page-link{
  background-color:var(--uas-azul);
  border-color:var(--uas-azul);
}

/* ======================
      BREAKPOINTS
======================= */

@media (min-width:1200px){
  table.tabla-uas th,
  table.tabla-uas td{
    font-size:1rem;
    padding:.9rem 1rem;
  }
}

/* 📱 Tablet */
@media (min-width:768px) and (max-width:1199.98px){
  table.tabla-uas th,
  table.tabla-uas td{
    font-size:0.9rem;
    padding:.65rem .7rem;
  }
}

    font-size:1.25rem;

  ];
  /* =========================================================
     SELECTORES (deben existir en tu HTML)
  ========================================================== */
  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);

  const busq   = $('#busquedaAlumnoMCA');
  const filtro = $('#filtroCohorteMCA');
  const tbody  = $('#tablaEgresadosMCA tbody');
  const pager  = $('#paginacionEgresadosMCA');

  if (!busq || !filtro || !tbody || !pager) {
    console.warn('MCA: No se encontraron elementos. Revisa IDs: busquedaAlumnoMCA, filtroCohorteMCA, tablaEgresadosMCA, paginacionEgresadosMCA');
    return;
  }

  const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
  let currentPage = 1;

  /* =========================================================
     Helpers
  ========================================================== */
  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str ?? '')
      .replace(/&/g,'&')
      .replace(/</g,'<')
      .replace(/>/g,'>')
      .replace(/"/g,'"')
      .replace(/'/g,''');
  }

  function safe(str) {
    return (str == null) ? '' : String(str);
  }

  function normalize(str) {
    return safe(str).toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  function pdfIconSvg() {
    // Icono simple (no depende de CSS para la URL, solo para estilo si quieres)
    return `
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true">
        <path d="M6 2h8l4 4v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <path d="M14 2v4h4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <path d="M8 13h8M8 16h8M8 19h5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </svg>`;
  }

  function sortByAlumno(arr) {
    return arr.slice().sort((a, b) =>
      safe(a.alumno).localeCompare(safe(b.alumno), 'es', { sensitivity: 'base' })
    );
  }

  /* =========================================================
     Poblar select de cohortes
  ========================================================== */
  (function fillCohortes() {
    // Respeta la opción "todas" que ya tienes en el HTML, solo añade las demás
    const cohortes = Array.from(new Set(DATA_MCA.map(r => safe(r.cohorte).trim())))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));

    cohortes.forEach((c) => {
      // Evita duplicar si ya existiera
      if ([...filtro.options].some(o => o.value === c)) return;
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = c;
      opt.textContent = c;
      filtro.appendChild(opt);
    });
  })();

  /* =========================================================
     Render
  ========================================================== */
  function render() {
    const texto = normalize(busq.value);
    const coh   = filtro.value;

    let filtered = DATA_MCA.filter((r) => {
      const alumno = normalize(r.alumno);
      const tema   = normalize(r.tema);
      const cohOk  = (coh === 'todas') || safe(r.cohorte) === coh;

      // Búsqueda por alumno (y opcionalmente por tema si quieres)
      // Si SOLO quieres alumno, deja solo alumno.includes(texto)
      const txtOk = !texto || alumno.includes(texto) || tema.includes(texto);

      return cohOk && txtOk;
    });

    filtered = sortByAlumno(filtered);

    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = 1;

    const start = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
    const pageRows = filtered.slice(start, start + PAGE_SIZE);

    tbody.innerHTML = pageRows.length
      ? pageRows.map((r) => {
          const cohorte = escapeHtml(r.cohorte);
          const alumno  = escapeHtml(r.alumno);
          const director= escapeHtml(r.comite);
          const tesis   = escapeHtml(r.tema);

          // PDF: si no hay r.pdf, mostramos guion
          const pdfLink = safe(r.pdf).trim();
          const pdfCell = pdfLink
            ? `<a class="enlace-pdf" href="${escapeHtml(pdfLink)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Abrir PDF">
                 ${pdfIconSvg()}
               </a>`
            : `<span class="text-muted">—</span>`;

          // Importante: data-label para que tu CSS móvil muestre etiqueta
          return `
            <tr>
              <td data-label="Cohorte">${cohorte}</td>
              <td data-label="Alumno">${alumno}</td>
              <td data-label="Director de Tesis">${director}</td>
              <td data-label="Nombre de la Tesis">${tesis}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        }).join('')
      : `
        <tr>
          <td colspan="4" class="text-center py-4">
            No se encontraron registros.
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;

    renderPager(totalPages);
  }

  function renderPager(totalPages) {
    const li = (label, page, disabled = false, active = false, aria = '') => `
      <li class="page-item ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} ${active ? 'active' : ''}">
        <a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="${page}" ${aria}>${label}</a>
      </li>
    `;

    let html = '';

    html += li('«', Math.max(1, currentPage - 1), currentPage === 1, false, 'aria-label="Anterior"');

    // Ventana de páginas
    const windowSize = 2;
    const pages = [];
    for (let p = 1; p <= totalPages; p++) {
      if (p <= 2 || p > totalPages - 2 || Math.abs(p - currentPage) <= windowSize) {
        pages.push(p);
      }
    }
    const unique = [...new Set(pages)].sort((a, b) => a - b);

    unique.forEach((p, i) => {
      html += li(p, p, false, p === currentPage);
      if (i < unique.length - 1 && unique[i + 1] !== p + 1) {
        html += `<li class="page-item disabled"><span class="page-link">…</span></li>`;
      }
    });

    html += li('»', Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1), currentPage === totalPages, false, 'aria-label="Siguiente"');

    pager.innerHTML = html;

    pager.querySelectorAll('a.page-link').forEach((a) => {
      a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = Number(a.getAttribute('data-page'));
        if (!Number.isNaN(target) && target >= 1 && target <= totalPages) {
          currentPage = target;
          render();
          // opcional: subir a la tabla
          const t = document.getElementById('tablaEgresadosMCA');
          if (t) t.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  /* =========================================================
     Eventos
  ========================================================== */
  busq.addEventListener('input', () => { currentPage = 1; render(); });
  filtro.addEventListener('change', () => { currentPage = 1; render(); });

  render();
});
</script>

  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);

  const busq   = $('#busquedaAlumno');
  const filtro = $('#filtroGeneracion');
  const tabla  = $('#tablaTesis tbody');
  const pager  = $('#paginacion');

  if (!busq || !filtro || !tabla || !pager) {
    console.warn('Tesis: Elementos de tabla/filtros no encontrados.');
    return;
  }

  const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
  let currentPage = 1;

  // Generaciones únicas para el select
  const generaciones = Array
    .from(new Set(DATA_TESIS.map(r => r.generacion)))
    .sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));

  generaciones.forEach((g) => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = g;
    opt.textContent = g;
    filtro.appendChild(opt);
  });

  function sortByAlumno(arr) {
    return arr.slice().sort((a, b) =>
      a.alumno.localeCompare(b.alumno, 'es', { sensitivity: 'base' })
    );
  }

  function render() {
    const texto = (busq.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const gen   = filtro.value;

    let filtrados = DATA_TESIS.filter((r) => {
      const coincideTxt = !texto || r.alumno.toLowerCase().includes(texto);
      const coincideGen = (gen === 'todas') || r.generacion === gen;
      return coincideTxt && coincideGen;
    });

    filtrados = sortByAlumno(filtrados);

    const total      = filtrados.length;
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = 1;

    const start    = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
    const pageRows = filtrados.slice(start, start + PAGE_SIZE);

    tabla.innerHTML = pageRows.length
      ? pageRows.map((r) => `
          <tr>
            <td>${r.generacion}</td>
            <td>${r.alumno}</td>
            <td>${r.tutor}</td>
            <td>${r.tesis}</td>
          </tr>
        `).join('')
      : `
        <tr>
          <td colspan="4" class="text-center py-4">
            No se encontraron tesis registradas.
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;

    renderPager(totalPages);
  }

  function renderPager(totalPages) {
    const li = (label, page, disabled = false, active = false, aria = '') => `
      <li class="page-item ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} ${active ? 'active' : ''}">
        <a class="page-link" href="#" data-page="${page}" ${aria}>${label}</a>
      </li>
    `;

    let html = '';

    // Anterior
    html += li('«',
      Math.max(1, currentPage - 1),
      currentPage === 1,
      false,
      'aria-label="Anterior"'
    );

    const windowSize = 2;
    const pages = [];
    for (let p = 1; p <= totalPages; p++) {
      if (p <= 2 || p > totalPages - 2 || Math.abs(p - currentPage) <= windowSize) {
        pages.push(p);
      }
    }
    const unique = [...new Set(pages)].sort((a, b) => a - b);

    unique.forEach((p, i) => {
      html += li(p, p, false, p === currentPage);
      if (i < unique.length - 1 && unique[i + 1] !== p + 1) {
        html += `
          <li class="page-item disabled">
            <span class="page-link">…</span>
          </li>
        `;
      }
    });

    // Siguiente
    html += li('»',
      Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1),
      currentPage === totalPages,
      false,
      'aria-label="Siguiente"'
    );

    pager.innerHTML = html;

    pager.querySelectorAll('a.page-link').forEach((a) => {
      a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = Number(a.getAttribute('data-page'));
        if (!Number.isNaN(target) && target >= 1) {
          currentPage = target;
          render();
          document
            .getElementById('tablaTesis')
            .scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  busq.addEventListener('input', () => {
    currentPage = 1;
    render();
  });

  filtro.addEventListener('change', () => {
    currentPage = 1;
    render();
  });

  // Primer render
  render();
});

  ];

  const FILAS_POR_PAGINA = 8;

  const elBusqueda   = document.getElementById("busquedaAlumnoMCA");
  const elFiltroGen  = document.getElementById("filtroGeneracionMCA");
  const elTablaBody  = document.querySelector("#tablaTesisMCA tbody");
  const elPaginacion = document.getElementById("paginacionMCA");

  // ✅ Si estás en otra página y no existe el HTML, no hagas nada
  if (!elBusqueda || !elFiltroGen || !elTablaBody || !elPaginacion) {
    return;
  }

  let paginaActual = 1;

  function normalizar(txt){
    return (txt || "")
      .toString()
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .trim();
  }

  function poblarGeneraciones(){
    const gens = [...new Set(DATA_TESIS_MCA.map(x => x.generacion).filter(Boolean))].sort();
    gens.forEach(g => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = g;
      opt.textContent = g;
      elFiltroGen.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function aplicarFiltros(){
    const q = normalizar(elBusqueda.value);
    const gen = elFiltroGen.value;

    return DATA_TESIS_MCA.filter(item => {
      const alumno = normalizar(item.alumno);
      const generacion = normalizar(item.generacion);

      const matchTexto = !q || alumno.includes(q) || generacion.includes(q);
      const matchGen = (gen === "todas") || (item.generacion === gen);

      return matchTexto && matchGen;
    });
  }

  function renderTabla(data){
    elTablaBody.innerHTML = "";

    if (data.length === 0){
      elTablaBody.innerHTML = `
        <tr>
          <td colspan="4" class="text-center py-4">
            No hay resultados con los filtros actuales.
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;
      return;
    }

    const inicio = (paginaActual - 1) * FILAS_POR_PAGINA;
    const fin = inicio + FILAS_POR_PAGINA;
    const paginaData = data.slice(inicio, fin);

    paginaData.forEach(item => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${item.generacion || ""}</td>
        <td>${item.alumno || ""}</td>
        <td>${item.tutor || ""}</td>
        <td>${item.titulo || ""}</td>
      `;
      elTablaBody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function crearItemPagina(label, active, disabled, onClick){
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    li.className = `page-item${active ? " active" : ""}${disabled ? " disabled" : ""}`;

    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.className = "page-link";
    a.href = "#";
    a.textContent = label;

    a.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (disabled) return;
      onClick();
    });

    li.appendChild(a);
    return li;
  }

  function renderPaginacion(totalItems){
    elPaginacion.innerHTML = "";

    const totalPaginas = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / FILAS_POR_PAGINA));

    // Prev
    elPaginacion.appendChild(
      crearItemPagina("«", false, paginaActual === 1, () => {
        paginaActual--;
        actualizar();
      })
    );

    const ventana = 2;
    const ini = Math.max(1, paginaActual - ventana);
    const fin = Math.min(totalPaginas, paginaActual + ventana);

    for (let p = ini; p <= fin; p++){
      elPaginacion.appendChild(
        crearItemPagina(String(p), p === paginaActual, false, () => {
          paginaActual = p;
          actualizar();
        })
      );
    }

    // Next
    elPaginacion.appendChild(
      crearItemPagina("»", false, paginaActual === totalPaginas, () => {
        paginaActual++;
        actualizar();
      })
    );
  }

  function actualizar(){
    const filtrados = aplicarFiltros();

    const totalPaginas = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtrados.length / FILAS_POR_PAGINA));
    if (paginaActual > totalPaginas) paginaActual = totalPaginas;

    renderTabla(filtrados);
    renderPaginacion(filtrados.length);
  }

  elBusqueda.addEventListener("input", () => {
    paginaActual = 1;
    actualizar();
  });

  elFiltroGen.addEventListener("change", () => {
    paginaActual = 1;
    actualizar();
  });

  poblarGeneraciones();
  actualizar();

});
</script>
